name: s23
text:
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds language-model answers in external documents [1]. Legal QA needs correct answers and
precise, complete source-page citations [2, 3]. PDFs may lack searchable text; evidence spans different text scales and may require exact
legal terms. Retrieving more passages can also introduce irrelevant pages.
